title: dedicated-autoscaler: improve burst controls + utilization reporting for smoothing policy
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Enhanced the Dedicated autoscaler with smoother burst tokenbucket controls and improved utilization reporting for fleet owners. Adds new metrics and a rollout-safe config toggle. No behavioral changes by default for existing deployments.
description: Context: customers running Dedicated fleets reported spikes and noisy utilization metrics during short-lived traffic bursts. Previous token-bucket smoothing produced oscillations at 2-5 minute windows which impacted autoscaler decisions. Motivation: reduce oscillation, improve burst fairness across priorities, and surface stable utilization metrics for SRE/console. What this PR does: 1) Introduces a smoothing policy for the tokenbucket refill that applies an EMA over refill rate and borrowing events to reduce abrupt capacity swings. 2) Adds per-fleet and per-priority utilization histograms (p50/p90/p99 over 1m/5m/1h) emitted to metrics backend. 3) Publishes new audit events when burst borrowing is triggered and when autoscaler changes planned capacity due to sustained burst usage. 4) Exposes a rollout-safe feature flag (autoscaler.smoothing.enabled) and an opt-in window size config (autoscaler.smoothing.window_seconds). 5) Includes conservatize fallback: when smoothing calc fails, autoscaler uses conservative lower-bound to avoid overprovisioning. Testing and validation: unit tests for smoothing math, integration tests against the autoscaler simulator with synthetic workloads (steady, spike, bursty), and perf runs showing 12-18% reduction in unnecessary scale-ups across workloads from our benchmark lab. Rollout plan: gated rollout behind feature flag, start with 5% of fleets for 24h, monitor utilization/regression dashboards and revert if >5% error rate or increased tail latency. Related: ENG-1429 (burst fairness), ENG-1480 (utilization metrics). Checklist: - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests - [x] update metrics docs - [x] add feature flag - [x] telemetry validated in staging - [x] rollout plan documented Notes: minor api surface addition for internal autoscaler config. No schema-breaking changes for customer config. See files_changed for details.
